title: Find Employees with BETWEEN Salary Range
description: Filter employees whose salary falls between a specified range using BETWEEN.

data.text: Write a query to find all employees whose salary is between $50,000 and $80,000 (inclusive).

data.title: SQL Solution
data.code:
SELECT EmployeeID, FirstName, LastName, Salary
FROM Employees
WHERE Salary BETWEEN 50000 AND 80000
ORDER BY Salary DESC;

data.title: Explanation
data.text: BETWEEN is inclusive of both endpoints. BETWEEN 50000 AND 80000 is equivalent to Salary >= 50000 AND Salary <= 80000. Be careful with dates — BETWEEN dates can be tricky due to time portions.
